title: Creamy Red Lentil Dal with Crispy Halloumi / Tofu / Seitan Crumbs
style: Ultra-creamy spiced red lentil dal topped with crunchy savoury crumbs
description: Rich, spoon-coating red lentil dal finished with lemon and topped with crispy halloumi, tofu, or seitan crumbs for contrast.

items.item: halloumi OR extra-firm tofu OR seitan

steps: Cook the Dal: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion with a pinch of salt and cook 8–10 minutes until soft and lightly golden.
Add garlic and ginger; cook for 1 minute. Stir in cumin, coriander, turmeric, and chilli flakes; toast for 30 seconds.
Add tomato purée and stir well. Add lentils and stock; bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer.
Cook 15–20 minutes, stirring often, until lentils are soft and breaking down.
Stir in coconut milk or yoghurt/cream and simmer 5 minutes more until thick and creamy. Season well and finish with lemon juice.
Crispy Topping: Heat oven to 200°C / 400°F. Grate halloumi or crumble tofu/seitan.
Toss with olive oil, smoked paprika, black pepper, and breadcrumbs. Spread on a baking tray and bake 20–25 minutes, stirring once, until golden and crunchy.
tips: Dal should be thick and spoon-coating — loosen with hot water if needed.
Halloumi gives maximum crunch and salt; tofu or seitan keep it vegan.
Add topping just before serving to keep it crisp.
